start.speaker: Vessit
start.text: Boss down, bearer down. I record both. The board does not care in which order.

r2.speaker: Vessit
r2.text: Four floors, no return of stores. That goes in the column that has no heading.

r3.speaker: Vessit
r3.text: Cleared and returned. I will mark the bounty settled and you will find another one on the board by tomorrow. That is how a board works.

r4.speaker: Vessit
r4.text: The swamp. Half of what I issue for the swamp comes back and none of it comes back dry.

r5.speaker: Vessit
r5.text: Ten. I keep the count because someone kept it for me once and it turned out to matter.

quiet.speaker: Vessit
quiet.text: Bounties rotate. Take what is up today; tomorrow is a different sheet.
